title: Gideon and the Landfall
premise: Marguerite Yarrow and her small salvage crew work the drowned frigate Gideon, a wreck the navy quietly forbids anyone to name, trading its secrets for just enough coin to stay afloat. When her old rival Odile Vasseur arrives with a concession permit and an offer Marguerite can't refuse, the crew is pulled into a race to raise the Gideon's sealed strongroom before the navy's salvage fleet arrives in six tides. Along the way, Marguerite discovers the compass she inherited points not north but toward the truth of her father's disappearance aboard the ship, and that Odile's job is bait in someone else's scheme. In the end, the crew chooses each other over the prize: they scuttle the strongroom rather than let it be weaponized, Marguerite lets go of the debt that defined her, and the found family sails out on a tide of their own making.
about_author: Yara Fairweather is the pen name of a former maritime archivist who spent a decade cataloguing wreck surveys before turning to fiction. She writes salt-stained adventure novels from a houseboat whose anchor has never once held.

chapters.title: The Wreck Nobody Names
chapters.summary: Marguerite dives the Gideon at dawn, salvaging brass while her crew keeps watch for navy patrol boats. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: weary competence masking dread, as the compass in her pocket swings wrong again.

chapters.title: Debt and Brass
chapters.summary: Back at the harbor, creditors circle and engineer Tam reveals the boat needs repairs they can't afford. POV: Tam. Emotional beat: quiet loyalty strained by poverty; the crew debates selling the compass.

chapters.title: Odile at the Door
chapters.summary: Odile Vasseur, Marguerite's old rival, arrives with a concession permit and an offer: help her reach the Gideon's strongroom before the permits expire. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: old wounds reopened; pride wars with desperation.

chapters.title: What Was Sworn Off
chapters.summary: Flashback woven through present argument: why the crew swore off the Gideon years ago after a diver died. POV: Bosun Ilya. Emotional beat: guilt resurfacing; the vote to accept the job splits the crew.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: The crew provisions and plots their route against the navy fleet's schedule; Odile reveals her mysterious backer only pays on delivery. POV: Odile. Emotional beat: calculated charm hiding fear of what she owes her patron.

chapters.title: The Compass Lies North
chapters.summary: At sea, Marguerite tests the compass and realizes it points along the Gideon's old patrol route, not magnetic north. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: vertigo of discovery—her father's last possession may be a key.

chapters.title: Fleet Smoke on the Horizon
chapters.summary: A navy tender spots them; the crew hides in a fog bank and loses a full tide. POV: young deckhand Nell. Emotional beat: terror and exhilaration; Nell proves herself under pressure.

chapters.title: The Drowned Town
chapters.summary: They shelter in a half-sunken village where survivors of the Gideon's sinking still live, and an old woman recognizes the compass. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: grief and warmth—the past is more alive than Marguerite believed.

chapters.title: Her Father's Log
chapters.summary: The woman gives Marguerite pages of her father's logbook describing the strongroom and a mutiny the navy covered up. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: fury crystallizing into purpose; memory as inheritance.

chapters.title: Odile's Patron
chapters.summary: Tam intercepts a coded message revealing Odile's backer is the same admiral who ordered the cover-up. POV: Tam. Emotional beat: betrayal and cold clarity; the crew must decide whether to confront or use Odile.

chapters.title: Confrontation in the Hold
chapters.summary: Marguerite corners Odile, who admits she was coerced—her brother is held as collateral. POV: Odile. Emotional beat: rival becomes reluctant ally; power's corruption shown through the admiral's leverage.

chapters.title: Third Tide, Rising Storm
chapters.summary: Halfway there with two tides lost, a storm forces them into a reef passage only Ilya can thread. POV: Ilya. Emotional beat: white-knuckle trust; the crew bonds through shared danger.

chapters.title: The Navy's Shadow
chapters.summary: They shadow the salvage fleet itself, learning the navy plans to blow the strongroom closed forever at permit's end. POV: Nell. Emotional beat: stakes sharpened—it's no longer treasure but truth at risk.

chapters.title: Descent
chapters.summary: With one tide left, Marguerite and Odile dive the Gideon together, navigating flooded corridors guided by the compass. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: claustrophobic courage; the compass pulls them true at last.

chapters.title: The Strongroom Door
chapters.summary: They breach the strongroom and find her father's final messages—and evidence the 'mutiny' was the admiral's own massacre. POV: Odile. Emotional beat: awe curdling into horror; the prize is poison.

chapters.title: Fleet Above
chapters.summary: The navy arrives early; divers drop charges while Marguerite and Odile are still below, air running out. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: desperate triage—save the evidence or themselves.

chapters.title: What We Carry Up
chapters.summary: They choose the logbooks over gold, escaping through a hull breach as the first charge detonates. POV: Odile. Emotional beat: sacrifice made freely; the debt between rivals dissolves.

chapters.title: Surface Fire
chapters.summary: The fleet opens fire on their boat; Ilya threads the reef again under shellfire while Tam broadcasts the logbook pages on open channels. POV: Tam. Emotional beat: defiant ingenuity; truth as a weapon turned outward.

chapters.title: The Admiral's Bargain
chapters.summary: Cornered, the admiral offers Marguerite everything—pardon, wealth, her father's record cleared—in exchange for silence. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: temptation at its purest; power offered as corruption's price.

chapters.title: Refusal
chapters.summary: Marguerite refuses, and the crew stands with her; but the broadcast has already reached journalists and the drowned town's survivors, making silence impossible. POV: Nell. Emotional beat: solidarity as strength; the powerless outmaneuvering the powerful.

chapters.title: Scuttling the Prize
chapters.summary: Rather than let either side control the strongroom, the crew collapses it with the navy's own charges, burying the gold forever. POV: Ilya. Emotional beat: bittersweet release; some things should stay drowned.

chapters.title: Tide of Our Own Making
chapters.summary: Weeks later, inquiries begin ashore and Odile frees her brother; the repaired crew sails for new wrecks, the compass now pointing honestly north. POV: Marguerite. Emotional beat: peace earned, family chosen, memory honored.
